title: Le Petit Prince (LPP) Multi-talker: Naturalistic 7T fMRI and EEG Dataset
description: This dataset comprises simultaneous 7T fMRI and EEG recordings from 25 native Mandarin Chinese speakers engaged in a naturalistic listening task featuring the Chinese version of Le Petit Prince under varying multi-talker conditions. Participants attended to different talker configurations (single male, single female, mixed male, and mixed female) while maintaining fixation, with comprehension assessed via post-run quiz questions. The dataset includes preprocessed anatomical and functional MRI data (fMRIPrep v20.2.0), raw EEG recordings, and behavioral measures, providing a rich resource for investigating neural mechanisms of selective attention and speech perception in complex acoustic environments. A French cohort was also included with adjusted session durations and without visual stimuli due to legal constraints. Note: The 25 participants comprise the primary Mandarin Chinese-speaking cohort; French cohort details are documented separately in the README.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a 64-channel actiCAP system sampled at 500 Hz with bandpass filtering (0.016–80 Hz). fMRI data were collected on a 7.0 T Siemens Terra scanner with functional sequences comprising 85 interleaved axial slices (1.6×1.6×1.6 mm voxel size, TR=1000 ms, TE=22.2 ms) and high-resolution anatomical T1-weighted images (MP-RAGE, 0.7×0.7×0.7 mm voxel size). Preprocessing included DICOM-to-NIfTI conversion, fMRIPrep pipeline (v20.2.0) for anatomical segmentation and MNI152NLin2009cAsym registration, motion and slice-timing correction, multi-echo ICA denoising, and voxel resampling to native and standard spaces.
